scope: 1,000 MUHS examination occurrences across Batch25 (138) + Batch26 (862)

verificationLevels.page_image_compared: Row checked against displayed pages of original source PDF, including numbering, marks and clinical subparts. Does not verify an answer key.
verificationLevels.pdf_text_layer_corroborated: Legacy manually transcribed question has moderate or better token concordance with its PDF text layer, but not every line was independently checked visually in this pass.
verificationLevels.pdf_text_layer_low_match: Legacy question has weak searchable PDF text concordance; source page needs visual confirmation (possibly OCR extraction problem).
verificationLevels.ocr_transcription_page_review_pending: Original source file fingerprint/paper page is linked; its question text has not yet been exhaustively compared visually.

sourceCaveat: Source identity, uniqueness and page validity are metadata integrity checks; they do NOT establish medically correct answers or error-free OCR.
